result.title: 固定查询：打赏金额
result.note: 保留的最简单固定业务查询；其它默认业务分析走Agent生成SQL。

queries.sql: SELECT key,value FROM metadata
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT user_id FROM users GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users WHERE user_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT streamer_id FROM streamers GROUP BY streamer_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM streamers WHERE streamer_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT session_id FROM view_sessions GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM view_sessions WHERE session_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT attempt_id FROM payment_attempts GROUP BY attempt_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts WHERE attempt_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT transaction_id FROM transactions GROUP BY transaction_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions WHERE transaction_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM view_sessions t
              LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.user_id LEFT JOIN streamers s ON t.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
              WHERE u.user_id IS NULL OR s.streamer_id IS NULL
SELECT date,COUNT(*) n FROM view_sessions WHERE date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY date
SELECT date FROM view_sessions GROUP BY date

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts t
              LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.user_id LEFT JOIN streamers s ON t.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
              WHERE u.user_id IS NULL OR s.streamer_id IS NULL
SELECT date,COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts WHERE date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY date
SELECT date FROM payment_attempts GROUP BY date

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions t
              LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.user_id LEFT JOIN streamers s ON t.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
              WHERE u.user_id IS NULL OR s.streamer_id IS NULL
SELECT date,COUNT(*) n FROM transactions WHERE date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY date
SELECT date FROM transactions GROUP BY date
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT attempt_id FROM transactions GROUP BY attempt_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN payment_attempts a ON t.attempt_id=a.attempt_id
        WHERE a.attempt_id IS NULL OR a.status!='success' OR t.date!=a.date OR t.user_id!=a.user_id
        OR t.streamer_id!=a.streamer_id OR t.amount_idr!=a.amount_idr

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts a LEFT JOIN transactions t ON a.attempt_id=t.attempt_id
        WHERE a.status='success' AND t.transaction_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions t WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM view_sessions v WHERE v.date=t.date AND v.user_id=t.user_id AND v.streamer_id=t.streamer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts WHERE amount_idr IS NULL OR typeof(amount_idr)!='integer' OR amount_idr<=0
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions WHERE amount_idr IS NULL OR typeof(amount_idr)!='integer' OR amount_idr<=0
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts WHERE status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('success','failed')
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users WHERE platform IS NULL OR platform NOT IN ('Android','iOS') OR channel IS NULL OR channel NOT IN ('organic','ads','referral') OR device_id IS NULL OR length(device_id)=0
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM streamers WHERE tier IS NULL OR tier NOT IN ('head','mid','tail')
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM view_sessions WHERE duration_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds<0
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT date,streamer_id FROM streamer_daily GROUP BY date,streamer_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM streamer_daily b LEFT JOIN streamers s ON b.streamer_id=s.streamer_id WHERE s.streamer_id IS NULL OR b.date IS NULL OR b.live_seconds IS NULL OR typeof(b.live_seconds)!='integer' OR b.live_seconds<0

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM view_sessions v LEFT JOIN streamer_daily b ON v.date=b.date AND v.streamer_id=b.streamer_id WHERE b.streamer_id IS NULL OR b.live_seconds<=0 OR v.duration_seconds>b.live_seconds

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM traffic_boost_daily b LEFT JOIN streamers s ON b.streamer_id=s.streamer_id WHERE s.streamer_id IS NULL OR b.allocated_units IS NULL OR typeof(b.allocated_units)!='integer' OR b.allocated_units<0 OR b.date IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM campaign_streamers c LEFT JOIN streamers s ON c.streamer_id=s.streamer_id LEFT JOIN campaigns p ON p.campaign_id=c.campaign_id WHERE s.streamer_id IS NULL OR p.campaign_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM streamers
SELECT date,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT streamer_id) uv FROM streamer_daily GROUP BY date
SELECT date,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT streamer_id) uv FROM traffic_boost_daily GROUP BY date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_idr),0) AS gift_amount_idr
FROM transactions WHERE date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
